items.title: David Einhorn Bought These 3 Dividend Stocks Last Quarter
items.summary: Key TakeawaysDavid Einhorn’s Greenlight Capital more than doubled its Comcast stake, added 55% to Viatris and opened a new position in SL Green Realty in the third quarter, its latest 13F shows. Comcast and Viatris both cover their dividends comfortably from free cash flow and trade at about 7x-8x forward earnings.
